context: A teen and her aunt visit a small theatre and chat afterward
purpose: Teach: 華/届き/幕/フード/膝/糸/にくく/りん

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 小さい劇場だったけど、華のある役者さんが何人もいたね。
lines.en: It was a small theatre, but there were several actors with real charisma.
lines.style: Warm aunt voice, reflective and softly impressed after the show.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、最後の幕が下りた瞬間、思いがちゃんと届きました。
lines.en: Yeah, the moment the final curtain came down, their feelings really reached me.
lines.style: Teen voice, sincere and quietly moved, slightly breathless.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 外は冷えてきたから、コートのフードをかぶった方がいいよ。
lines.en: It's getting chilly outside, so you'd better pull up your coat's hood.
lines.style: Caring aunt tone, practical and gentle, mild maternal concern.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう。座ってる間、膝の上にずっとパンフレット置いてた。
lines.en: Thanks. The whole time I was sitting, I kept the pamphlet on my lap.
lines.style: Teen voice, casual and chatty, slightly stiff from sitting.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あの衣装、細い糸で刺繍が入ってて本当に綺麗だったね。
lines.en: Those costumes had embroidery done in fine thread; they were really beautiful.
lines.style: Aunt voice, admiring and observant, savouring the details.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 席が遠かったから少し見えにくくて、双眼鏡欲しくなっちゃった。
lines.en: Our seats were far, so it was a bit hard to see; I wanted binoculars.
lines.style: Teen voice, slightly complaining but cheerful, lighthearted regret.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: じゃあ帰りに八百屋さんでりんご買って、家でゆっくり話そうか。
lines.en: Then let's grab some apples at the greengrocer on the way and chat at home.
lines.style: Aunt voice, warm invitation, suggesting a cozy wind-down together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいね、紅茶も淹れて、今日の感想ちゃんとまとめたい。
lines.en: Sounds good, let's brew tea too; I want to properly gather today's impressions.
lines.style: Teen voice, enthusiastic and a touch thoughtful, looking forward.
